codingcat-agent-toolkit.description: CodingCat.dev Agent Toolkit & Design System MCP Server (Cloudflare Worker via Hono). Exposes list_codingcat_rules, get_codingcat_rules, and get_codingcat_tokens.

chrome-devtools.description: Chrome DevTools MCP Server (github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp). Lets agents inspect rendered HTML/GSAP/Three.js/Remotion video frames, audit DOM bounds, catch overlapping text, and verify layout before MP4 export.

blender.description: Blender MCP Server (github.com/ahujasid/mcp-for-blender). Lets AI agents create, manipulate, rig, and render 3D scenes in Blender.
